stations.title: Bram
stations.note: She was on the dock all along.

stations.title: Write routes
stations.text: Open to anyone who finds the URL.

captions: Anyone can now change the fleet. On Saturday night, someone deleted Otter.
The write routes are open to the world, and errors show their insides.
You write the lock, one safe place for errors and a request id.
Now a delete without a staff token is refused, and Otter stays.
Only staff change the fleet, and every error is safe to show.
